video_title: Hotwav R9 Pro Max (review): Best Of Rugged Tablet?
evidence: SponsorRadar identifies HOTWAV as the sponsor of Teoh on Tech's July 29, 2026 English-language YouTube review 'Hotwav R9 Pro Max (review): Best Of Rugged Tablet?'. HOTWAV sells tangible consumer hardware including smartphones, rugged phones, and tablets. HOTWAV's current official affiliate program explicitly accepts social-media creators/ambassadors and its official contact page publishes marketing@hotwav.com specifically for Marketing/Promotion Collaborations. HOTWAV and hotwav.com returned no match in the permanent GitHub sponsor repository search immediately before staging.
